scope: Opt-in BY modal preconditioner and shared computational stopping convention; no binary physical acceptance inherited
reference: Inherited BY spectral equations, zero initial guess and native stopping criteria (sin3 max norm <=1e-12; linear absolute L2 target=dmax*1e-3)

final_data_acceptance.physical_H_M_difference_bound: max(1e-7, 5*largest corresponding finite-difference step variation in reference or candidate)

independent_projection_inverse_acceptanc.reference: Physical-grid even cyclic average of original SetMatrix_JFD; all Fourier partners, rectangular grids, reflected faces/corners, changed current correction and masses

matched_stopping_experiment.physical_check: Independent fourth-order Cartesian differences at identical six points; g=1 required for every stencil sample; steps .004,.002,.001
matched_stopping_experiment.limitation: Maps, seed geometry, PDEs, component count and finite-resolution accuracy differ. A common computational stopping convention is not equal physical accuracy.

timing_acceptance: Only report speedup when both solves and numerical data equivalence pass; fresh processes, sequential CPU workers, two interleaved repeats. Prototype screens are diagnostic.
